about: Who the Public Records & Investigations tab covers (docs/records-tab-spec.md, section 3). Phase 1 lists the qualifying roles only. The people holding them are filled in from official sources, each with its source URL and linked to their official profile by official_id, just before the pilot. A role whose holders have no official profile on ThePillory yet (senior White House staff) waits until they do. official_source is the page that lists a role's holders; it's empty until that page is checked, when the holders are filled in.

roles.name: Senior White House staff (Chief of Staff, National Security Advisor, Counsel to the President, and others at that level)
House leadership: the Speaker, the majority and minority leaders, and the majority and minority whips
Senate leadership: the majority and minority leaders and the majority and minority whips
